title: The Litany Engine
premise: Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers.

sensory: The air carries a dry mineral taste of powdered bone.
Tiny clicks move through the walls whenever the room goes quiet.
visual: The mortar is packed with folded prayer slips and pale hair.
hazards: A pressure slab releases hanging bonework when crossed carelessly.
A thread of rosary beads pulls open a reliquary of sharp fragments.
rewards: A bone fragment acts as a key to sacred locks.

roomBriefs.name: 01 Skull Lined Corridor
roomBriefs.premise: Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers.
roomBriefs.sensoryLayer: cold incense · The room tastes dry and mineral, as if each breath scrapes through old bone dust. · Small clicks travel through the bonework, like teeth settling after speech.
roomBriefs.hazard: A pressure slab releases hanging bonework when crossed carelessly. · A sermon text is carved into a floor slab polished by knees and footsteps.
roomBriefs.encounter: Bone ornaments create brittle cover and collapsing lines of sight. · Skull shelves and femur screens divide the room into narrow devotional lanes.
roomBriefs.clue: A skull row reveals that one skull has been replaced recently. · One skull in the row is cleaner than the others, and the dust line behind it does not match.

roomBriefs.name: 02 Ossuary Gallery
roomBriefs.sensoryLayer: bone dust · The room tastes dry and mineral, as if each breath scrapes through old bone dust. · Small clicks travel through the bonework, like teeth settling after speech.
roomBriefs.hazard: A thread of rosary beads pulls open a reliquary of sharp fragments. · A strand of beads runs ankle-high between two reliquary niches.
roomBriefs.encounter: Opening a reliquary causes the room to answer in bone clicks. · When the reliquary opens, every skull niche begins clicking like a dry choir.
roomBriefs.clue: The chandelier’s bone pattern mirrors the room layout. · The bone chandelier repeats the map below in miniature, including one room no door reaches.
